snippet.title: Phantom Thief Celianna - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
From the creators of Treasure Hunter Claire and President Yukino, comes a Stealth Action game where you must dodge traps and enemies in order to steal the treasures of those who would oppress society.

Buy it on Steam:
http://bit.ly/2RpLTXK

Kagura Games on Steam:
http://bit.ly/2SibPSb

Developer: Acerola
Publisher: Kagura Games
